name: read_file
description: Read a line-numbered excerpt from a local file (regular files only; directories are not supported; absolute paths only). Use offset/limit to page: a large limit for a broad overview during discovery, a small limit for a precise line-range read once you know the region you need.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a regular file to read (directories are not supported; some sensitive paths are blocked).

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default: 1).

limit.description: Number of lines to read (default: 1000). During discovery, use a large limit for a broad overview; once you have located the relevant region (a symbol or line range), pass a small limit (e.g. 20-40) to read just that slice and avoid pulling unrelated lines. Very large results are additionally capped by a per-read character limit; when that happens the output ends with a truncation notice telling you the exact offset to continue from.
